author: deenius
text:
Hi IF

I often have to think about your statement:

I'm not even a part time trader now, so I miss nearly every piece of action there is.

If I ever open the charts and see a trade opp right in front of me, I take it.

However, I usually get between 10R and 25R per trade. If I lose, it's usually no more than the spread and commission.

There are between 5 and 20 such confirmed trades available every day.

I'm pretty sure that you know that TIME IS THE MOST VALUABLE ASSET in the whole world. So, I would like to know your answer (opinion) to this question:

If I will trading only QMs and DMs during london session (4 hours per day), am I able to find enough trading opportunities?

I'm not looking for giant trades. But I would like to make 5 % daily
with risk of 1 %. I think it is quite reasonable goal. What you think?

Please, be realistic and honest

Thank you

author: Ifmyante
text:
Your 5R per day is very possible, especially if you work only in the realm of the tick chart, where PA is almost always pure.

However, if it's time you want in your life, trading HTF only is the way to go.

So many times I waited fourteen hours for price to go that extra five pips to where I wanted to trade.

The ITs tend to regularly mix it up. Just like sports teams, who have a
number of different plays they'll take out for different matches.

author: ahdat
text:
It's funny, I started learning about the world markets and
inadvertently went down the rabbit hole and approximately came to the
same conclusion as IF. At the end of the day, it's just human behavior,
 driven with layers with motivations, resources, and social networks. I
 think a lot of people have a hard time believing it because they live
by a different set of values that those with extreme amounts of wealth
and power. These people that have been holding onto this wealth and
power for hundreds of years, will do anything they can to continue
protecting their resources. That's a very simple human concept. Now
spread that over hundreds of years, billions of people, thousands of
corporations, hundreds of governments and you have a convoluted web that
 makes it difficult for most people to see, and that's when they duck
their head in the sand. EVERYTHING has been gamed by elites because
humans are easily corruptible. They hold the most valuable resource in
the world at the moment: money.

The sickening part is how far they have gone, and how good they have
become and masking all this from the general population. Think wars for
 profit, conspiracies to take away civil liberties, slaves through
capitalistic imperialism, perception control through media, corporate
masked charities, for sale governments, etc... And most of us turn a
blind eye because we are addicts to their system through consumerism,
hooked with debt. But cracks are forming as the greed has gotten out of
 hand and the middle class continues to dwindle. The fix for them is
easy, to give some of that power and wealth back to the people. But
that's not how people operate, and they will continue to protect their
interests at the expense of the rest of humanity.

Its such a convoluted topic, but it's sort of like price action reading.
 If you start to understand the basic building blocks of the world
stage (world banks, governments, corporations, extremely wealthy and
powerful families and entities, etc...) add in a layer of human behavior
 and psychology, and start putting together those pieces have operated
throughout history, the story becomes really clear.

author: ahdat
text:
Also for those looking for more direct 'evidence', this is an
investigative endeavor, they are doing what they can to hide their
intentions and actions. Like investigating a crime, you start with
facts and bits of evidence. Apply intuition, logic, and reasoning to
continuing to tease out more evidence. Rinse and repeat until the
puzzle is put together.

author: Ifmyante
text:
Beautifully put!

And yes. For now, finding out the truth is not as easy as reading it
from a book. It is an investigation, which leads down a very deep and
dark rabbit hole indeed!
